about_short_description.short_description: PAX revolutionizes capital markets as the first crypto exchange to operate on a single chip, removing the need for a full data center.

product.name: PAX λ API
product.description: An ultra-low latency API enabling instant order placement and execution within the exchange chip, minimizing network delays for algorithmic traders and market makers.

product.name: Zero-Fee Trading with Cash-Back Rebates
product.description: A trading model where all standard marketable and limit orders incur no fees and receive cash-back rebates, funded by fees charged to high-frequency market makers using the λ API.

product.name: Exchange Integrated Alpha Models
product.description: AI-powered price prediction models integrated into the exchange to provide real-time trading insights for users of the PAX λ API.
